color.note: One palette and one theme for everything Dori makes (the user, 2026-10-28): paper white, ink and the pale sage, plus two sage tones for shapes and secondary text on a sage fill. Two surfaces use it: paper (dorizza.com, Resource covers, share cards) and display (the videos). The raster and video themes are retired. The fx-* tokens are the colour roles of the video effects library (effetti-video): every effect draws through them.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The paper: dorizza.com, Resource covers, share cards, the knock-out inside the halftone silhouette. Never textured, never a gradient. In video it is the white of the caption words.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Ink: all type and every line that must read, on bg (19.8:1) and on accent (14.4:1). In video, the type and marks on a sage card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The pale sage, the brand's one hue. On paper, always a fill under fg: chips, the detection label, the button's square, link hover, the strongest offer's panel; 1.4:1 on bg, so never text or a thin line there. In video, the ground of every card and full-frame visual (the LCD field) and the type over his footage (on-footage).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Type and marks on an accent fill: 14.4:1.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: A darker sage for shapes on an accent fill, never text (2.4:1): avatar discs, the mascot's side and tube. Paper has no flat grey: there a grey is ink through the dither masks.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on an accent fill (6.8:1): counters, meta lines. On paper secondary text is fg.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: A second highlight on an accent fill, video only (5.7:1). Paper has one signal: the sage.

tokens.name: on-footage
tokens.usage: Type over his footage: the big text behind his head and the spoken caption word, always on shadow-text, never on a box or bar.

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: The other caption words over his footage, white on shadow-text.

tokens.name: detect
tokens.usage: The Apple Vision face box and its label cell: 2px on paper (stroke-detect), 5px over footage (stroke-card). The label's text is fg.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Alias of bg, kept for files that name the paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Alias of fg: press ink, the halftone dots and the drawn masthead.

tokens.name: pale-sage
tokens.usage: Alias of accent: the site's signal and the video's LCD green are the same colour.

tokens.name: fx-surface
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'surface' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Light cards, panels, pills and bubbles: the sage.

tokens.name: fx-on-surface
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'on-surface' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Text, lines and icons on an fx-surface card.

tokens.name: fx-dark
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'dark' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Dark cards, panels and bars: ink.

tokens.name: fx-on-dark
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'on-dark' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Text and icons on an fx-dark card.

tokens.name: fx-over
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'over' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Type and marks drawn straight on his footage; the library adds its own shadow.

tokens.name: fx-paper
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'paper' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Printed paper in an effect: the receipt, the magazine, the newspaper.

tokens.name: fx-accent
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'accent' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). The one signal on a sage card (the library's Claude orange, Instagram blue, highlighted word): ink.

tokens.name: fx-on-accent
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'on-accent' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Text on an fx-accent fill.

tokens.name: fx-accent2
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'accent2' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). A second highlight, and the 'done' state of a button (Segui già).

tokens.name: fx-success
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'success' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Ticks, switches turned on, a graph that climbs.

tokens.name: fx-danger
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'danger' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). The stamp, the REC dot, the heart, the error bar: ink, never red.

tokens.name: fx-muted
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'muted' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Secondary text on a sage card: counters, meta lines, placeholders.

tokens.name: fx-line
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'line' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). Outlines, rules, empty boxes, tracks.

tokens.name: fx-ground
tokens.usage: Effects library role 'ground' (effetti-video, effetti/theme.py ROLES). A room that replaces his: never used in video (no cutout over a flat colour); kept so the role is defined.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section headings on the site: clamp(2.75rem, 1.4rem + 4.6vw, 6rem), 96px at full width. Offer headings and work names go to -0.04em.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Secondary headings and card titles: clamp(1.625rem, 1.2rem + 1.2vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Show the work, then explain it plainly.
styles.usage: The paragraph beside a section heading, 34 to 40ch: clamp(1.25rem, 1.05rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every credential links to something real: a live product, a repo, a paper.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Insegna qualsiasi cosa al tuo agente con i video di YouTube.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Notes, consent text; nav links at 15px, weight 500.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button labels; the large button runs 17 to 21px.

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: The one shout on a Resource cover (1600x840 px), upper case, fitted to its width. Italian, 1 to 3 words, the reader's benefit.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Detection labels, years, ranks, outcome numbers, figure captions, with tabular figures: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.35vw, 1.375rem).

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips: a live status or a Resource type.

styles.name: mark
styles.usage: The nav mark and the language switch.

styles.name: lockup-step
styles.usage: The big text behind his head (STEP 01 to STEP 06), 860 px wide, in on-footage on shadow-text. Every lockup row is sized by tools/lockup.py so the rows share one width; this is the STEP size.

styles.name: video-button
styles.usage: The Segui button: an fg bar with accent type, 400x120.

styles.name: video-card
styles.usage: Text inside a comment card or reply card, 104 px tall.

styles.name: facebox-tag
styles.usage: The face box's label over footage.

styles.name: caption-phrase
styles.usage: Phrase captions, white with the spoken word in on-footage, on shadow-text and no box, the first line always centred on caption-line. One size for the whole video; a phrase ends where the next word would leave the line.

spacing.note: dorizza.com's eight steps. Use only these on paper.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: consent row gap, figure caption offset.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Form gaps, callout padding, skip link inline padding.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Section head gap, callout inline padding.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Gaps between rows of a group.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: Below a section head; a section's bottom padding.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: A section's top padding.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: The largest break.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter: clamp(16px, 2.8vw, 40px), inside a 1520px frame.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: The fixed nav bar's height.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner: buttons, chips, inputs, panels, images, cards, lockup bars, video cards.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The one round form: a halftone dot, a Matrix Sans dot, the avatar disc in a comment card.

shadow.note: Paper is flat: a shadow there is only a 1px line in disguise. Video has depth: type over his footage stands on shadow-text, never on a box (the user, 2026-10-28); the cover keeps its hard plate.

tokens.name: shadow-line
tokens.usage: A 1px fg line drawn as an inset shadow: line chips, inline code, the progress bar's outline.

tokens.name: shadow-text
tokens.usage: Video only: under every word over his footage (captions, the big text behind his head). On an element whose reveal slot clips (overflow: hidden), use the same two layers as filter: drop-shadow() on its parent.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Video only: under a card or an effect's element over his footage, so it lifts off the room. Never on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: The hard offset plate under a browser window on a video cover. Paper never lifts anything.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The structural line on paper: section rules, row dividers, ruled panels, inputs, link underlines.

tokens.name: stroke-detect
tokens.usage: Paper only: the detection stroke, the overlay card's top rule, the error frame.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline, fg, 3px offset (2px around form rows).

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Video: comment cards and the face box over footage.

tokens.name: stroke-cover
tokens.usage: Covers: the Resource covers' ink line and the video cover's browser window.

frame.note: The vertical master, 1080x1920 at 30fps, and the zones the platforms leave free.

tokens.name: frame-w
tokens.usage: Master width. One render serves Shorts, Reels and TikTok.

tokens.name: frame-h
tokens.usage: Master height. Never landscape, never letterboxed.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: 0.12 H: nothing that must read sits above it.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: 0.78 H: caption and card blocks end above it (platform captions, username).

tokens.name: rail-x
tokens.usage: 0.82 W: the right action rail starts here below about 0.45 H.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: 0.05 W: side gutter.

tokens.name: caption-line
tokens.usage: 0.70 H: the one caption slot. The first line of every phrase is centred here for the whole video; a segment moves it only for a need it states.

tokens.name: cover-safe-top
tokens.usage: The top of the band a cover's shout must stay in to survive the 3:4 and 1:1 crops.

tokens.name: cover-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: The bottom of that band.

duration.note: Video motion from tools/hf_motion.js (M.dur), then the site's own timings.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: a rise, a wipe, a card that arrives.

tokens.name: dur-move
tokens.usage: Moves between positions.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Exits, always shorter than entrances.

tokens.name: dur-land
tokens.usage: The one overshoot of a shot, on its key word.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: A caption phrase popping in (3 frames).

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Between related elements: never all at once.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Site: the button's square growing, the arrow sliding.

tokens.name: dur-check
tokens.usage: Site: the checkbox's ink square scaling in.

tokens.name: dur-register
tokens.usage: Site: plates sliding into register (rules 140ms after the sage).

tokens.name: dur-afterimage
tokens.usage: Site: the VHS afterimage exit, dither 50, 25, 12 with jolts of -7, 5, -3px.

easing.note: GSAP names for HyperFrames (M.ease), and the site's CSS curve.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: arrive fast, land soft.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Moves.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: ease-land
tokens.usage: The one overshoot per shot.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: A held element breathing: a slow push to 1.04, never a dead freeze.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The site's one curve, in CSS, for every transition but the 120ms linear link hover.
